Several distinct-ID overlaps also remain. Bounded native safe-ID+geometry follow-up confirms near-coincident duplicates and distinct-ID overlaps; no published status/lifecycle/grouping semantics explain them.

blocker: Do not filter, repair or select by arbitrary type/year/status. Hold runtime integration pending a source-owner contract explaining how duplicate object IDs and overlapping fiscal lot IDs should be grouped or interpreted. City identity is confirmed by the exact WUP city code and fresh local research; source topology and repeated native IDs remain unresolved.
